name: Gwenmund Cobb
role: patient in the forge ward; pit-hand's widow
backstory: Widow of a roc-wounded pit-hand and mother of Branda, Tam and Mina, Gwenmund has the burn at its very first stirring and ordinary pyre-cough. She declined the Quenching for now and will learn to hold the heat with Isine.
secrets: She hid her flush until the ward found it.

relationships.name: Okton
relationships.how: promised to shelter her children if she dies
